# bamr87 - consolidated README

> This fleet spans the full learning-to-shipping lifecycle, pairing educational content with the tooling and infrastructure that supports it. Interactive and reference learning resources—bashcrawl's shell-scripting dungeon, the it-journey educational IT platform, and the OverTheWire wargame guides—are complemented by production-oriented pieces including the barodybroject full-stack application platform and the zer0-mistakes Jekyll theme for GitHub Pages.
